structured.feedback: Good to ship. At about 170 words, the Markdown description has subheadings, active voice and a call to action. It covers the dermaplaning USP and pairs features with benefits, such as non-slip grip giving control and compact size suiting travel. It avoids weaknesses, links, made-up quotes and overpromising like "painless" or "suitable for men". Two minor flaws: some phrases repeat ("touch-ups", "smooth/smoother"), and it calls the product one razor in one place but says "each razor" in another.
